topPicks.title: No Elizabeth line between Stratford and Romford over Christmas
topPicks.content: Major railway works in East London mean there will be no Elizabeth line services between Stratford and Romford over Christmas. Engineering works on Anglia route (c) Network Rail The closure is due to major engineering work on the Great Eastern Main Line at Forest Gate, where Network Rail plans a 10-day programme to renew six sets of points, along with associated rails, sleepers and ballast. The Great Eastern Main Line at Forest Gate is a critical artery into the capital, supporting hundreds of passenger services every day and enabling freight trains to transport goods and supplies across the country as part of the strategic freight network. However, the track renewal will affect Greater Anglia and Elizabeth line services on the Great Eastern Main Line to and from London Liverpool Street. Martin Beable, Chief Operating Officer for GBR Anglia said: “While most of the railway will remain open as usual over the festive period, we’ll be taking advantage of a quieter time on the network to carry out significant improvements at Forest Gate and Barking station. “We’re also carrying out lots of smaller projects across East Anglia on Christmas Day and Boxing Day which will help us maintain a safe, reliable and efficient railway for the hundreds of passenger and freight services that use these routes every day. “We’re grateful for passengers’ patience while this work takes place and would encourage anyone travelling over Christmas and New Year to check their journey before setting off.” Unrelated works west of London will also mean no Elizabeth line west of Paddington – leaving just a shuttle service in the centre running. Travel Information: Friday 25 and Saturday 26 December 2026 – all routes As usual, trains will not run on most routes on Christmas Day and Boxing Day. A limited Stansted Express service will operate on Boxing Day between Stansted Airport and Tottenham Hale only. Trains will call at Tottenham Hale, Cheshunt, Harlow Town, Bishops Stortford and Stansted Airport. Cheshunt station will be open between approximately 10:30-19:45 Sunday 27th December 2026 to 3rd January 2027 During the 10 days of engineering work at Forest Gate, a rail replacement service will operate between Ingatestone/Shenfield and Newbury Park (London Underground station). Greater Anglia customers’ tickets will be accepted between Newbury Park and Stratford / Liverpool Street. Elizabeth line trains will not operate between Stratford and Romford, and a rail replacement bus service will operate. A reduced train service will run between Romford and Shenfield. Note: the Liberty Line will operate, so you may be able to get from Romford to Upminster and continue your journey that way as well. Slower, but no buses involved.
